ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a bar chart, the vertical-axis unit is "100 million t", and the horizontal axis is, in order, China, the United States, India, and Japan; the legend shows that the gray bars indicate "coal production", and the white bars indicate "coal consumption". Each country has two bars, production and consumption, so the size of coal output and consumption demand in the same country can be compared. Then reason: the stem asks what indicator of the corresponding countries can be roughly calculated with the help of production and consumption. Therefore fill in "coal self-sufficiency rate".
